title: Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence: A Field Experiment
authors: Sebastian Maximillian Krakowski; Darek Haftor; Johannes Luger; Natallia Pashkevich; Sebastian Raisch
eligible_reason: Field experiment in a pharmaceutical sales force: AI recommendation system introduced for all treated sales experts in the same quarter (qdate 217 = 2014q2; post is a common date). Three-arm design (D1 control, D2, D3) with treat##post, so a single adoption cohort and multiple treatment arms. Main models add a time-varying experience control (exp_ind). Not staggered.
design_notes: MS-SPI-22-03849_dofile.do: Table 5 xtreg calls/sales i.treat##i.post exp_ind i.year i.quarter, fe cluster(bus_unit) with wild-cluster bootstrap p-values; robustness with outcome transforms, lags, subsamples by KAI style, Poisson (xtpoisson, ppmlhdfe), event study reghdfe calls b217.Dyear; Table 7 mediation (mixed models).
data_files_note: README: all data necessary to reproduce the results are included (field experiment data, Jan 2013-Jun 2017).
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Single-onset experiment; not staggered.
